title: Forage, a payments processor that helps retailers and food-delivery companies accept EBT cards, raised a $40M Series B led by Mouro Capital at a $225M valuation (Yuliya Chernova/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Yuliya Chernova / Wall Street Journal: Forage, a payments processor that helps retailers and food-delivery companies accept EBT cards, raised a $40M Series B led by Mouro Capital at a $225M valuation — Forage secures venture funding as it expands food-stamp payment processing despite declining federal enrollment
